summary: Solstad Offshore ASA owns and operates offshore service vessels. The company owns and operates construction service vessels and anchor handling tug supply vessel and; and provides maritime services to offshore energy industry. It offers renewable energy services, subsea support operations, node seismic operations, subsea construction activities, support for well stimulation operations, and subsea and mooring installations; and additional services, such as ROVs, tooling, project personnel, and engineering support, as well as engages in oil and gas activities. The company owns a fleet of six vessels which includes three construction service vessels and three anchor handling tug supply vessels. It operates in the North Sea, North and Central America, Mediterranean/rest of Europe, Africa, South America, Australia, and Asia. Solstad Offshore ASA was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Skudeneshavn, Norway.
